title: Income Certificate (MeeSeva)
department: MeeSeva — Department of Electronics & Communication, Government of Telangana
summary: State-issued proof of a household's annual income, needed for scholarships, fee reimbursement and income-based welfare schemes.
description: The income certificate is issued through MeeSeva centres and the MeeSeva portal for residents of Telangana. Applications are processed by the Mandal Revenue Officer and the certificate carries a verification code that can be checked online.

steps: Apply at a MeeSeva centre or through the MeeSeva portal
Submit the application with identity and address details
Pay the MeeSeva service fee at the counter or online
Collect the digitally signed certificate, which carries a verification code
